title: Substack partners with AI-detection tool Pangram, allowing users to scan text longer than 100 words for an estimate of how much was written with AI assistance (Chris Best/The Substack Post)
summary: Chris Best / The Substack Post: Substack partners with AI-detection tool Pangram, allowing users to scan text longer than 100 words for an estimate of how much was written with AI assistance — Building trust in the AI age — It's getting harder to tell what's real on the internet. — This is less true on Substack, and we aim to keep it that way.
contentText:
Chris Best / The Substack Post :

Substack partners with AI-detection tool Pangram, allowing users to scan text longer than 100 words for an estimate of how much was written with AI assistance   —  Building trust in the AI age  —  It's getting harder to tell what's real on the internet.  —  This is less true on Substack, and we aim to keep it that way.
